channel.title: Bangladesh Capital & Money Markets — Daily Pulse
channel.description: AI-curated daily Good / Bad / Ugly assessment of developments in the Dhaka Stock Exchange and the broader Bangladesh money markets.

item.title: [GOOD] BSEC Proposes Stronger Corporate Restructuring Oversight
item.description:
Category: Good

The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) is drafting new Corporate Restructuring Rules for 2026, seeking public input. These proposed rules aim to make BSEC review mandatory before any court approval for corporate restructuring, enhancing regulatory oversight and investor protection.

Why this matters: Increased regulatory scrutiny in corporate restructuring processes can protect investor interests and improve market transparency.
